evidence: Its builder said their team uses Plannotator for specs and code review, then compiles feedback into evolving review skills.

evidence_sources.author: ramoz
evidence_sources.excerpt: I've built and my team uses plannotator [1] for specs and code review. It stores all human annotated feedback, which we compile from time-to-time and iterate on coding standard skills for automated review (that seems to get better with the more feedback we provide).
